findings.title: Final work can exceed two seconds and still report diagnostic completion
findings.detail: The two-second work cutoff is checked only before each configuration probe. The final SetInformationJobObject call, Job-empty query and receipt publication can return after two seconds, after which line 124 marks diagnostic_completed. Final acceptance at lines 146-148 checks only the four-second total. The 3.7-second hard guard limits liveness but does not prevent a 2-to-3.7-second work phase from claiming completion.
findings.requested_change: Preserve R1 and create a new diagnostic revision that captures the work-finished elapsed time after the final work API/query and refuses completion if the unchanged two-second bound has been reached. Retain the four-second total and hard guard, and record the captured work time.

accepted_source_properties: Imports exact helper definitions without calling either worker or supervisor. The diagnostic creates one anonymous empty Job and never calls CreateProcessW or another child-launch API.

Captures structure sizes/offsets and immediate CreateJob/SetInformationJob API results plus Winerror; both exact flags and the same-64MiB/no-working-set alternate are explicitly diagnostic observations only.
Empty-job query and close are guarded; source/interpreter pins, 16KiB exclusive/atomic receipt bounds and the 3.7s hard total guard remain. A missing or pending receipt makes no completion claim.
execution_preconditions: Do not execute R1 for the requested bounded diagnostic qualification; review the new exact source revision first.
The diagnostic cannot qualify the helper or native campaign, and alternate flags do not authorize production changes.
